Want to go deeper with your practice?
You can get your first month free with the link above. Easy to cancel anytime if you feel its not for you.
In this 40 min daily yoga routine, we focus on:
• building strength and mobility
• improving flexibility and posture
• connecting breath to movement
• creating a calm, steady mind
This is a full body yoga class you can use as your daily practice whether you’re looking to feel better in your body, recover, or stay consistent with movement.
